consensus: Nobody builds Shabraz-first at scale on the PAIR. EDHREC's 3,974 Brallin//Shabraz decks are a wheel/discard deck in every filter the brief asked for: the Upgraded (bracket 3, 339 decks) page's top non-mana cards are Windfall 74%, Faithless Looting 70%, Frantic Search 63%, Swords 61%, Tolarian Winds 56%, Glint-Horn Buccaneer 54%, Curiosity 53%; the Voltron theme (42 decks) and the Upgraded x Voltron cross (15 decks) are the same deck with Swiftfoot Boots and Lightning Greaves on it, and no equipment, aura, double-strike or extra-combat card reaches the listing cut on any pair page. The nearest real-world analogue to the pilot's build is SOLO Shabraz (274 WU decks, 21 of them Upgraded): 'card draw that turns every extra card into a +1/+1 counter and life, then kills with a huge flying Shabraz' (edh.wiki) — Chasm Skulker 55%, Teferi's Ageless Insight 54%, Wizard Class 49%, Psychosis Crawler 47%, Thought Vessel 64%, Reliquary Tower 71%, Swiftfoot Boots 48%, Rogue's Passage 39%, and a draw-out finisher (Laboratory Maniac 38%, Drogskol Reaver 35%, Jace WoM 20%, Approach 19%). Against the Upgraded pair page, jaws-v1 lacks 49 nonland cards at 20%+ inclusion, and 33 of those 49 are discard-side cards the pilot traded away on purpose; the sixteen that are not discard-side are the real gap list and are mostly interaction (Path, Counterspell, Arcane Denial, Dovin's Veto, Blasphemous Act, Generous Gift, An Offer You Can't Refuse) plus Curiosity/Ophidian Eye/Tandem Lookout, Chasm Skulker, Psychosis Crawler, Niv-Mizzet x2, Thought Vessel, Lightning Greaves. The protection suite jaws-v1 runs (Boots + seven free/instant spells) is already above the consensus shape of 'two boots plus two to four free spells'. The pilot's candidate list splits cleanly: Curiosity/Ophidian Eye/Tandem Lookout/Tolarian Winds/Captain Howler/Glint-Horn are consensus cards for the WHEEL deck (23–56% Upgraded); Chrome Host Seedshark, Loan Shark, Knowledge Is Power, Tireless Tribe, Narset Waymaster and Ghyrson Starn are minority plays (3–15% of pair lists); Unsettled Mariner, Mystic Reflection, Surestrike Trident, Bazaar Trademage (0.7%), Dack Fayden and Kindred Discovery have no measurable presence in any Brallin/Shabraz list.

findings.claim: THE 'VOLTRON' FILTER IS THE WHEEL DECK WEARING BOOTS. Voltron-tagged pair decks (42) run Windfall 32/42, Faithless Looting 30/42, Frantic Search 28/42, Magus of the Wheel 27/42, Glint-Horn 24/42, Curiosity 22/42, Captain Howler 20/41; the protection on that page is Swiftfoot Boots 20/42 and Lightning Greaves 14/42, Boros Charm 14/42, Fierce Guardianship 9/42, Loran's Escape 4/42, Flawless Maneuver 4/42, Mask of Memory 4/42. The Upgraded x Voltron cross (15 decks) is the same: Faithless Looting 12/15, Glint-Horn 11/15, Windfall 11/15, Frantic Search 11/15, Curiosity 7/15. Enumerated by type line across every fetched page, the equipment that reaches a listing cut is: pair page Swiftfoot Boots 1390, Lightning Greaves 1100, Mask of the Schemer 214/3974 (5%); Voltron page Robe of the Archmagi 5/42, Mask of the Schemer 4/42, Mask of Memory 4/42 (in), The Reaver Cleaver 3/42; Upgraded x Voltron Fireshrieker 1/15 (in), Darksteel Plate 1/15, Shadowspear 1/15; solo Shabraz Mithril Coat 24/274, Robe of the Archmagi 23, Whispersilk Cloak 22, Shadowspear 18, Brotherhood Regalia 15. Auras beyond Curiosity/Ophidian Eye: pair page none at the cut; solo Staggering Insight 64/274, Steel of the Godhead 49, Aqueous Form 36, Righteous Authority 20, Light of Promise 16. Double strike by oracle text: Boros Charm 632/3974 (16%, one mode), Raking Claws 250/3974 (6%), Drogskol Reaver 96/274 solo (run for its draw trigger), True Conviction 23/274 solo, Fireshrieker 1/15 and Duelist's Heritage 1/15 on Upgraded x Voltron; extra combat: Full Throttle 1/5 on the Humans page and nothing else. Lizard Blades, Embercleave, Akroma's Will, Blade Historian, Sword of Feast and Famine, Champion's Helm, Relentless Assault, Moraug, Aurelia, Combat Celebrant and Karlach are below the cut on every page. The EDHREC average voltron 99 has no double strike and no extra combat. Reading: the branch's double-strike finish (Fireshrieker, Lizard Blades, Blade Historian, Akroma's Will) is the pilot's own idea with no inclusion signal behind it either way — the data cannot say it is wrong, only that nobody else is doing it.

SOLO SHABRAZ (274 DECKS) IS THE SHABRAZ-FIRST ARCHETYPE, AND ITS SPINE IS PARALLEL GROWERS PLUS NO-MAXIMUM-HAND-SIZE. The solo page's top synergy cards are all draw-matters bodies and engines: Chasm Skulker 151/274 (55%, +0.49), Teferi's Ageless Insight 147/274 (54%, in), Wizard Class 134/274 (49%), Psychosis Crawler 128/274 (47%), Windfall 135/274 (in), Ominous Seas 118/274, Shark Typhoon 118/274 (in), Body of Knowledge 94/274, Oneirophage 86/274 (+0.31), Proft's Eidetic Memory 87/274, Toothy 73/274, Alhammarret's Archive 97/274, Decanter of Endless Water 105/274, Sphinx's Revelation 102/274, Winged Words 79/274. Hand-size pieces are near-universal: Reliquary Tower 194/274 (71%), Thought Vessel 176/274 (64%); on the 21-deck solo Upgraded page Thought Vessel is 15/21 and Alhammarret's Archive 12/21. edh.wiki: 'The deck stacks cheap draw, wheel effects and counterspells, so Shabraz grows on every turn, not just yours.' jaws-v1 runs NONE of the no-maximum-hand-size effects (Thought Vessel left in v3.0.0; Reliquary Tower is not in the list; enumerated from the branch's cards.json oracle text — Teferi's Ageless Insight and Mask of Memory do not grant it) and none of the solo page's parallel growers (Chasm Skulker, Oneirophage, Toothy, Body of Knowledge, Proft's Eidetic Memory, Wizard Class); its own draw-triggered growers are Shang-Chi (a counter per draw) and Prince Imrahil (a Human token per second draw), both from the branch's cards.json oracle text. Pair-page figures for the hand-size pieces: Reliquary Tower 1769/3974 (45%), Thought Vessel 1108 (28%), Wizard Class 654 (16%), Proft's Eidetic Memory 445 (11%); Upgraded: Tower 157/339 (46%), Vessel 106 (31%), Wizard Class 56, Proft's 46, Library of Leng 22. Branch cards that agree with solo consensus: Teferi's Ageless Insight, Brainstorm 161/274, Swords 176/274, Swiftfoot Boots 132/274, Shark Typhoon, Esper Sentinel 83/274, Rhystic Study 92/274, Consecrated Sphinx 65/274, Faerie Mastermind 56/274, Negate 101/274, Prince Imrahil 43/274, Archmage Emeritus 40/274, Shang-Chi 18/91, Bard 15/73, Voracious Greatshark 54/274.

WHAT THE UPGRADED (BRACKET 3) PAIR PAGE RUNS THAT JAWS-V1 LACKS, SPLIT BY WHETHER THE PILOT CUT IT ON PURPOSE. 49 nonland cards sit at 20%+ of the 339 Upgraded decks and are not in the branch. 33 are discard-side (oracle text contains 'discard'; the engine v3.0.0 traded away): Faithless Looting 238/339 (70%), Frantic Search 214 (63%), Tolarian Winds 191 (56%), Glint-Horn 183 (54%), Rielle 166 (49%), The Locust God 165 (49%), Magmakin Artillerist 161/337 (48%), Ominous Seas 161 (47%), Captain Howler 158/337 (47%), Change of Fortune 147 (43%), Marauding Mako 147/337 (44%), Thrill of Possibility 140 (41%), Faithful Mending 137 (40%), Heartwarming Redemption 135 (40%), Surly Badgersaur 133 (39%), Monument to Endurance 131/337 (39%), Forgotten Creation 129 (38%), Izzet Charm 124 (37%), Ghostly Pilferer 119 (35%), Cathartic Reunion 114 (34%), Ledger Shredder 102 (30%), Neutralize 96, Fateful Showdown 92, Raugrin Crystal 90, Careful Study 88, Scrounging Skyray 85/337, Decaying Time Loop 84, Wheel of Misfortune 82, Bag of Holding 77, Containment Construct 73. The SIXTEEN that are not discard-side are the honest gap: Curiosity 178/339 (53%), Path to Exile 163 (48%), Counterspell 147 (43%), Psychosis Crawler 145 (43%), Boros Signet 138 (41%, cut in jaws-v1 for Ceremonial Knife), Niv-Mizzet the Firemind 109 (32%), Niv-Mizzet Parun 106 (31%), Thought Vessel 106 (31%), Arcane Denial 104 (31%), Dovin's Veto 103 (30%), Blasphemous Act 103 (30%), Lightning Greaves 101 (30%), Ophidian Eye 85 (25%), Chasm Skulker 83 (24%), Tandem Lookout 78 (23%), An Offer You Can't Refuse 75 (22%), Commander's Sphere 73 (22%), Generous Gift 71 (21%), Whirlwind of Thought 68 (20%). Lands at 20%+ the branch lacks: Plains 322/339 (the branch runs 2 Island, 1 Mountain and no Plains), Mystic Monastery 190, Reliquary Tower 157, Prairie Stream 141, Glacial Fortress 136, the cycling lands (Forgotten Cave 127, Secluded Steppe 122, Lonely Sandbar 121, Irrigated Farmland 116, Ash Barrens 111). Interaction is the one class where the gap is not a deliberate trade: the branch answers with Swords, Get Lost, Chaos Warp, Negate, Stubborn Denial, Prismari Command, Kozilek's Return, Voracious Greatshark, Collective Defiance and Otawara; the consensus adds Path, Counterspell, Arcane Denial, Dovin's Veto, Blasphemous Act, Generous Gift and An Offer You Can't Refuse.

THE PROTECTION SUITE SHAPE IS TWO BOOTS PLUS TWO TO FOUR FREE OR INSTANT SPELLS, AND JAWS-V1 IS ALREADY ABOVE IT. Pair page: Swiftfoot Boots 1390/3974 (35%), Lightning Greaves 1100 (28%), Fierce Guardianship 878 (22%, a Game Changer — the deck's fourth, so not available), Deflecting Swat 699 (18%, in), Boros Charm 632 (16%), Teferi's Protection 375 (9%); Upgraded: Boots 107/339, Greaves 101/339, Fierce Guardianship 55, Deflecting Swat 54, Boros Charm 57, Teferi's Protection 25. Solo Shabraz adds the voltron-flavoured pieces: Rogue's Passage 107/274 (39%), Steel of the Godhead 49/274 (18%), Aqueous Form 36/274 (13%), Teferi's Protection 30/274, Render Silent 28/274, Shelter 24/274 (9%, in), Whispersilk Cloak 22/274, Brotherhood Regalia 15/274. The one fetched Shabraz-first list with a protection category (Archidekt 'Sharpedo', razer17, tags Draw/Voltron/Combo, est. bracket Core) runs nine: Archon of Absolution, Baird, Gods Willing, Loran's Escape, Shelter, Slip Out the Back, Swiftfoot Boots, Whispersilk Cloak, Windborn Muse, plus four evasion pieces (Aqueous Form, Key to the City, Security Bypass, Steel of the Godhead). jaws-v1 runs eight: Swiftfoot Boots, Shelter, Slip Out the Back, Loran's Escape, Flawless Maneuver, Deflecting Swat, Grand Abolisher, Akroma's Will — more than the consensus and the same count as the one voltron list found. Slip Out the Back, Loran's Escape and Flawless Maneuver are below the listing cut on every pair page (Voltron 4/42 each) — the pilot's choices, not the crowd's. What the suite lacks against consensus: Lightning Greaves (30% Upgraded), Boros Charm (17%), Teferi's Protection (7%); against solo Shabraz: Rogue's Passage and Steel of the Godhead (evasion, not protection).

FINISHERS: THE CROWD CLOSES WITH THE PING LOOP OR A DRAW-OUT, ALMOST NEVER WITH DOUBLE STRIKE AND NEVER WITH EXTRA COMBAT. On the pair page the finisher is the Brallin + Curiosity-class loop (Curiosity 2329/3974 = 59%; combo-tagged page 82/92) and amplifiers for the ping are a minority (Ojer Axonil and Torbran were 7–8% in the 2026-09 recon; Gratuitous Violence and Fiery Emancipation remain below the cut). On the solo page the finisher is decking: Laboratory Maniac 103/274 (38%), Drogskol Reaver 96/274 (35%; Spellbook: Shabraz + Reaver 'Infinite card draw', 'Spicy / Bracket 3-4+', 6,735 decks), Jace, Wielder of Mysteries 56/274, Approach of the Second Sun 51/274, Thassa's Oracle below cut. Knowledge Is Power (team +X/+X for cards drawn this turn) is 25/274 (9%) on solo and below the cut on the pair; The auras the solo crowd puts on Shabraz are Staggering Insight 64/274 (23%; lifelink and a draw on combat damage), Steel of the Godhead 49/274 (18%), Aqueous Form 36/274 (13%), Righteous Authority 20/274 and Light of Promise 16/274 — all evasion or draw, none double strike. The one double striker on the solo page is Drogskol Reaver 96/274, run for the draw loop. MTGRocks (Nathan Ball, 2026-04-26) names Chandra's Ignition and Soul Immolation as the ways to 'leverage their scaling bodies' and The Ozolith / The Ooze to 'maintain your stash of accumulated counters post-removal'; it does not mention double strike or extra combat. SCG (Bennie Smith, 2020-04-13) mentions Blackblade Reforged only in passing. Reading: a 21-commander-damage kill off one flying body is the pilot's plan; the sources offer three ways to make the counters pay that the branch does not run — Knowledge Is Power (one wheel = +7/+7 team), Chandra's Ignition (Shabraz's power to every other creature and every opponent — but not commander damage), and The Ozolith (counters survive removal).

HUMAN TYPAL SUPPORT DOES NOT EXIST IN ANY LIST; SHARK TYPAL IS EIGHT TO NINE NAMED SHARKS. The Humans theme on the pair is 8 of 3,974 decks and its own top-synergy cards are Sharks (Captain Howler 5/5 +0.99, Marauding Mako 5/5 +0.99, Thunderhead Gunner 4/4, Loan Shark 5/8, Voracious Greatshark 5/8); Kindred Discovery is 2/8 there and absent everywhere else; no Human anthem reaches the cut on any pair or solo page; the Human-matters cards that do are token makers — Valiant Rescuer 441/3974 (11%), Pouncing Shoreshark 343/3974 (9%, a Shark that bounces a Human), Stroke of Midnight 27/339 Upgraded, The Queen of Dale 65/873 — and, inside the 8-deck Humans filter only, the Rohan/Gondor Humans at 2–3/8 (Faramir, Greymond, Beregond, Théoden, Éowyn, Minas Tirith Garrison, Mass Appeal). The Humans the solo page does run are the drawing ones: Esper Sentinel 83/274, Prince Imrahil 43/274, Archmage Emeritus 40/274, Shang-Chi 18/91, Bard 15/73 — the branch has all five plus Willie Lumpkin, Sokka, Valeria Richards, Inti, Blade Historian, Grand Abolisher and Magus of the Wheel (twelve Humans in the 99 plus Brallin, from the branch's cards.json type lines). The Sharks theme (25 decks) runs Marauding Mako 21/25, Captain Howler 20/25, Voracious Greatshark 18/25 (in), Shark Typhoon 17/25 (in), Thunderhead Gunner 16/25, Chrome Host Seedshark 16/25, Loan Shark 15/25, Bigfin Bouncer 15/25, Daggermaw Megalodon 12/25, Jaws 9/23 (in). jaws-v1 holds three Sharks (Shabraz, Jaws, Voracious Greatshark). SCG (2020): the author 'planned a Humans and Sharks tribal deck but found too few Sharks' and built cycling instead. Reading: Brallin's trample grant has three Shark cards in the branch (Shabraz, Jaws, Voracious Greatshark) plus Shark Typhoon's tokens; the Sharks page's extra bodies are Seedshark (flying), Loan Shark, Bigfin Bouncer (ETB bounce — an answer on a Shark body) and Thunderhead Gunner (reach, a loot) — Mako and Howler are discard-side.

THE PILOT'S CANDIDATES, BY WHAT THE CROWD ACTUALLY DOES WITH THEM. (a) Consensus cards of the WHEEL deck: Curiosity pair 2329/3974 (59%) / Upgraded 178/339 (53%) / solo 40/274 (15%); Tolarian Winds 2227 (56%) / 191 (56%) / solo 79 (29%) — left this deck in v3.0.0; Glint-Horn Buccaneer 2252 (57%) / 183 (54%) — left in v3.0.0, pure discard-side; Captain Howler 1948/3799 (51%) / 158/337 (47%) / Sharks 20/25 — discard-side trigger, Shark body; Ophidian Eye 1223 (31%) / 85 (25%); Tandem Lookout 1117 (28%) / 78 (23%) — a HUMAN that soulbonds with Shabraz so both draw on damage, i.e. the only Curiosity-class card that is also a flying-grant target; Ghostly Pilferer 1545 (39%) / 119 (35%) — cut from this deck in v2.2.0. (b) Minority plays with a measurable count: Chrome Host Seedshark 592 (15%) / 43 (13%) / Sharks 16/25 / solo 65/274 (24%, High Lift) — staged then unstaged in jaws-v1; Loan Shark 550 (14%) / 36 (11%) / Sharks 15/25; Tireless Tribe 405/3974 (10%, from its card page; below the pair page's cut) — a W Human free discard outlet that pays only Brallin; Idyllic Tutor 324 (8%) / 31 (9%) — left in v3.0.0 after Q044 measured it the weakest slot; Knowledge Is Power solo 25/274 (9%), pair below cut; Library of Leng Upgraded 22/339 (6.5%), Voltron 4/42; Ghyrson Starn pair 143/3974 (3.6%, from its card page) — on Ghyrson's own 19,905-deck page the build is Curiosity 89%, Ophidian Eye 69%, Niv-Mizzet Parun 67%, Tandem Lookout 65%, i.e. the Curiosity-loop deck; Narset, Jeskai Waymaster pair 123/3588 (3.4%), Voltron 3/40, card-draw 7/95; Bazaar Trademage pair 28/3974 (0.7%). (c) No presence in any Brallin/Shabraz list (below cut on all eleven pair/solo pages fetched AND no pair hit on the card's own EDHREC page): Unsettled Mariner (42,899 decks), Mystic Reflection (42,740), Surestrike Trident (6,334), Dack Fayden (22,462), Kindred Discovery (352,926; Humans page 2/8 only). Shark Typhoon is in the branch and is consensus everywhere: pair 1686 (42%), Upgraded 124 (37%), solo 118/274 (43%), Humans page 6/8 top synergy.

GHYRSON STARN IS A BRALLIN-SIDE CARD WITH AN ORACLE-TEXT CONFLICT AGAINST A KEEP. Ghyrson: 'Whenever another source you control deals exactly 1 damage to a permanent or player, Ghyrson Starn deals 2 damage to that permanent or player.' Brallin's discard ping and Jaws's sacrifice ping each deal exactly 1 to each opponent, so Ghyrson makes each 3 — Draftsim (Jeff Dunn, 2022-11-10, upd. 2024-12-26): 'Ghyrson turns their single damage into three'; EDHREC (Michael Whelan, 2025-04-22) calls Curiosity 'a perfect fit' for him. But Torbran, Thane of Red Fell (a keep) makes a red source's 1 damage into 3 BEFORE Ghyrson looks at it, and 3 is not 'exactly 1', so with Torbran out Ghyrson adds nothing to Brallin or Jaws. Shabraz's combat damage is never 1. Commander Spellbook lists 12 Ghyrson combos and none includes Brallin, Curiosity, Ophidian Eye, Tandem Lookout or Glint-Horn, so there is no indexed loop to worry about; whether the two amplifiers stack in any order is a rules question for a stack scenario, not recon.

THE CURIOSITY LOOP'S BRACKET LABEL HAS NOT MOVED. Commander Spellbook, Brallin + Curiosity (fetched 2026-11-20): prerequisites 'Curiosity attached to Brallin' and 'You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size'; steps 'During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size' → 'Brallin triggers for each card discarded' → 'Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card for each damage dealt' → 'Pass priority, moving to an additional cleanup step' → repeat; label 'Spicy' / 'Bracket 3-4+', 'Probably 3 or 4, but hard to classify', 5,343 decks. EDHREC's combo panel for the pair lists Brallin + Curiosity (5,343 decks), Glint-Horn + Curiosity (16,904) and Brallin + Ophidian Eye (2,297). The combo-tagged pair page (92 decks) runs Curiosity 82, Ophidian Eye 68, Glint-Horn 64, Tandem Lookout 57, Fierce Guardianship 38, Underworld Breach 36. Because Brallin is always in the command zone, ANY ONE of Curiosity / Ophidian Eye / Tandem Lookout is a two-card infinite available in every game of this deck. The bench's own rule for the bracket is the pilot's to apply (`bracket-check`), and the no-maximum-hand-size question from the 2026-09 recon still stands: the loop's stated prerequisite is a hand ABOVE maximum at cleanup, which Thought Vessel / Reliquary Tower / Wizard Class / Library of Leng remove.

known_failure_modes: Shabraz dies with his counters: 'Shabraz is vulnerable to removal once it has grown' (edh.wiki); MTGRocks (2026-04-26) recommends The Ozolith / The Ooze to 'maintain your stash of accumulated counters post-removal'.

Pressured before the engine runs: 'small creatures with few blockers can pressure the deck before the draw engine gets going' (edh.wiki) — the shape of captain's-log game 009 (land-heavy keep, no early bodies, whole table attacked).

Self-decking on the draw-out: Shabraz + Drogskol Reaver ends in 'drawing from an empty library' unless 'In response to the final Shabraz trigger, remove a combo piece or win the game' (Commander Spellbook).

Draw with no hand to hold it: the solo lists run Reliquary Tower 71% and Thought Vessel 64% because a Shabraz turn draws past seven; a list without a no-maximum-hand-size effect discards the surplus at cleanup (and, if Brallin is out with a Curiosity-class card, starts the loop whether or not that was the plan).

The wheel deck's failure modes from the 2026-09 recon (wheeling with no payoff, becoming the table's target, over-wheeling) apply to the draw-sevens the pilot kept: a draw-seven with Shabraz not yet on the battlefield puts seven counters on nothing.
contested: Shabraz-first at all: no article, primer or filter builds the PAIR around Shabraz; the Upgraded, Voltron, Card Draw, +1/+1 Counters, Flying and Aggro theme pages are all the wheel/discard deck. The only data that resembles the pilot's plan is the WU solo-Shabraz page (274 decks), which cannot speak to red or to Brallin. Treat 'the crowd does not do this' as absence of evidence, not evidence of absence — but size any 'most lists run X' claim against the solo page, not the pair page.

Curiosity-class cards at a bracket-3 table: 53% of Upgraded (bracket 3, self-labelled) pair decks run Curiosity, so the crowd's bracket-3 includes the loop; Spellbook says 'Probably 3 or 4, but hard to classify'. Tandem Lookout is the version that is also a Human and a soulbond draw engine for Shabraz without Brallin. The pilot's bracket rule decides, not this artifact.

No-maximum-hand-size versus the cleanup loop: the solo consensus (Tower 71%, Vessel 64%) and the Curiosity loop's prerequisite ('hand size greater than your maximum') pull opposite ways. If the deck stays combo-free the hand-size pieces are a straightforward gap; if a Curiosity-class card goes in, they are a stack question.

Double strike / extra combat as the finisher: the only double strike the pair crowd runs is Boros Charm (16%, as one mode) and Raking Claws (6%); the solo crowd's is Drogskol Reaver (35%, for its draw loop) and True Conviction (8%); extra combat is Full Throttle 1/5 on the Humans page. The sources close with the ping loop (pair) or a draw-out / Knowledge Is Power / Chandra's Ignition (solo). The branch's Fireshrieker / Lizard Blades / Blade Historian / Akroma's Will package has one hit (Fireshrieker 1/15 on Upgraded x Voltron) and is otherwise unmeasured by anyone but this bench.

Ghyrson Starn: a real 3x multiplier on Brallin's and Jaws's pings, and a dead card whenever Torbran (a keep) is on the battlefield, because Torbran's +2 makes the damage 3, not 'exactly 1'. 3.6% of pair lists run him; his own page is the Curiosity-loop deck.

Discard-side consensus versus the pilot's direction: 33 of the 49 most-run Upgraded cards the branch lacks are discard payoffs or loot/rummage spells. The 2026-09 recon's advice (cheap loots over big wheels) was advice for the wheel deck; v3.0.0 and the captain's log ('Discard is a cost' — games 005, 006, 007) rejected that deck. This artifact does not re-recommend them.

gaps: Self-check: four superlatives in the first draft of this artifact ('zero equipment beyond the boots', 'no double strike anywhere', 'Steel of the Godhead the only aura', 'no Human-matters card') were refuted by enumerating type line and oracle text across the fetched pages and were re-scoped; the figures that survive are the enumerated ones.

No primer, article or EDHREC filter exists for a Shabraz-first build of the PAIR; everything about Shabraz-first here is read off the WU solo page (274 decks) and two Archidekt lists, which cannot speak to red, Brallin, Torbran or Jaws.
No Reddit thread on Shabraz or the pair surfaced in four searches (two with site: filters, which the engine ignored); nothing from a discussion forum is cited.

The Moxfield 'Brallin, The Last Shark Rider [cEDH Primer]' (403), Bell of Lost Souls 'Commander of the Week: Brallin' (403) and the TCGplayer 'Playing With Power S09E07' decklist (page returned no content) could not be fetched and are not cited.
EDHREC's bracket filter is self-labelled by deck owners; 'Upgraded = bracket 3' is their label, not a bracket-check, and 53% of those lists run a two-card infinite (Curiosity).

No inclusion data exists for the branch's double-strike package (Fireshrieker, Lizard Blades, Blade Historian, Akroma's Will), for Slip Out the Back / Loran's Escape / Flawless Maneuver beyond 4/42 on the Voltron page, or for Willie Lumpkin, Sokka, Valeria Richards, Enduring Curiosity, Mask of Memory, Ceremonial Knife, Kozilek's Return, Get Lost on the pair page — all below the listing cut, which bounds each below roughly 2% of 3,974, not at zero.

Whether Ghyrson Starn and Torbran can be sequenced so both apply (Ghyrson's 'exactly 1' is checked on the damage dealt after Torbran's replacement) is a rules question — settled_by resolve-stack, not recon.
The Humans/Sharks typal question has no crowd answer: 8 Humans-tagged decks and 25 Sharks-tagged decks is too few to call anything consensus; the Shark counts are reported as fractions of 25.

Inclusion percentages for Captain Howler, Mako, Artillerist, Jaws, Skyray and Gunner use their own potential_decks (lists built after the card's release), so they read higher than the same count over 3,974 would.
